# How long does a customer take to pay back what you spent to win them?

> Free SaaS CAC payback calculator: churn-adjusted payback months, LTV, LTV:CAC and the most you can spend to acquire a customer for a target payback. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
